# Blue Operator Pool Service

> Blue Operator Pool Service (Blue Operator Inc.) provides residential weekly pool service, pool repair, acid and chlorine washes, and pool leak detection for homes across Miami-Dade County, Florida, from Coral Gables and Key Biscayne to Kendall and Homestead. Founded by Manuel Prado. Phone: 305-925-4491. Email: service@blueoperatorpool.com. Hours: Mon–Fri 8:30 AM–6:00 PM, Sat 8:30 AM–1:00 PM, Sun closed (Eastern Time). English and Spanish spoken.

Key facts:

- Weekly service on a consistent schedule, with two plans: BlueProtect (weekly cleaning, water balancing, and equipment checks) and BlueProtect Plus (adds extended plaster protection, priority response for repairs and storms, and monthly filter cleanings).
- Standard chemicals (chlorine, acid, stabilizer, etc.) are included with every plan. Specialty chemicals, salt cell cleanings, major storm cleanups, and repairs or installations are extra, and customers always get an estimate before any additional work.
- No long-term contracts; service is month-to-month.
- No Missed Stop Guarantee: GPS-tracked visits, plus a detailed service report with photos after each visit.
- No Green Guarantee: if a pool turns green under Blue Operator's watch, it is fixed for free.
- Most new clients are added within 24–48 hours.
- Financing is available on repairs.
- 5.0 stars on Google, 500+ happy clients, 9+ years of experience, 31 zip codes serviced.
- Insured.

## Services

- [Weekly pool service](https://www.blueoperatorpool.com/services): Weekly cleaning plans that keep water clear and surfaces protected.
- [Pool repairs](https://www.blueoperatorpool.com/repairs): Pumps, filters, salt systems, and other pool equipment.
- [Acid and chlorine wash](https://www.blueoperatorpool.com/acid-wash): Deep surface cleaning to remove stains, algae, and discoloration.
- [Leak detection](https://www.blueoperatorpool.com/leak-detection): Finding why a pool is losing water.
- [Our work](https://www.blueoperatorpool.com/our-work): Before and after photos of pools we’ve brought back across Miami-Dade.

## Contact

- [Get a free estimate](https://www.blueoperatorpool.com/contact): Request service online, or call or text 305-925-4491.
